officialSources.observation: Bethesda requires public evidence of author permission for ports where the porter is not the original author/co-author; permissions must match the porting scope.
Bethesda cites Creation Kit EULA language prohibiting fees/commercial exploitation of Game Mods without express prior written consent of an authorized ZeniMax representative.
Official Bethesda Game Studios page publishes Bethesda Softworks LLC general contact details and info@bethsoft.com.

entries.note: The official general contact is not proven to be the correct licensing/permission destination for MODARYX hosting/distribution/commercial scope.

officialSources.observation: CDPR permits specified fan-content/mod activity subject to its rules and the relevant EULA, and publishes legal@cdprojektred.com for questions or advance permission in certain out-of-scope cases.
Current User Agreement points users to Fan Content Guidelines and governs Cyberpunk 2077, while product-specific rules may also apply.

entries.note: An official legal contact exists, but MODARYX hosting/distribution/commercial scope still requires scoped interpretation and, where necessary, legal review/explicit authorization.

officialSources.observation: Usage Guidelines distinguish community/fan allowances from commercial-company use, reserve rights, and direct formal partnership proposals to the official partnership path.
Official partnership proposal form is currently available.

entries.note: The formal partnership path is proven to exist, but no proposal has been submitted and no MODARYX-specific permission exists.

closureStatement: This refresh strengthens official-source provenance only. It does not close any of the 19 external VF blockers.
